classes._post: post = render scale of the post chain (EffectComposer) in CSS px x post; null = the renderer DPR. Capped by the renderer DPR and px; never below 1; saver / ?look=0 = 1

devices._note: model identifier -> [RAM GB, name]. Unconfirmed identifiers are left out and take the unknown path (iPhone -> phone, iPad -> tablet): iPhone 17e, iPad Pro (M5), iPad Air (M4). An unknown identifier older than the oldest one listed here (lower major number) is low

screens._note: Web 版の機種の推定（MR.Cine.guessModel）: screen の短い辺 x 長い辺 @ devicePixelRatio → 同じ画面の機種 id（RAM は devices）。拡大表示（Display Zoom）だと小さい機種の値になる

look._note: cinematic-interiors V2 X1 (farlook.js): far-city window colours (weights in %, groundOnly = indices only on the ground floor), lit share per building (offices = styles 3-6 in blocks of blockFloors floors x blockBays bays, homes = brick styles 1-2 scattered; far windows = average colour + farVar of the 4x3 block colour), roof palette, per-building tint (value +-, hue +- degrees, saturation x). enabled false or ?look=0 = off
